statements.status_notes: Reviewed quay.io/stackstate/stackstate-k8s-process-agent:c570527c on 2026-07-21. Grype 0.112.0 reports the advisory against github.com/containerd/containerd v1.7.33 in /opt/stackstate-agent/bin/agent/process-agent, but the upstream affected package is the distinct github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 module.
statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-50195 affects only github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 versions in the 2.1, 2.2, and 2.3 release lines. The process-agent binary links github.com/containerd/containerd v1.7.33, whose Go module path does not contain the /v2 major-version suffix. Go major versions two and later use distinct module paths, and the affected /v2 component is not linked into this binary. The Grype finding results from matching the /v2 advisory to the major-v1 module after module-path normalization.
statements.action_statement: Retire this statement when scanner matching no longer maps github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 advisories to the major-v1 module. Re-review if process-agent starts linking github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 in an affected release line.

statements.status_notes: Reviewed the process-agent Linux command dependency graph at commit 464045ac95f7f081804c10b7d5b9ea42437dc4b0. The scanner reports the parent x/crypto module, but the affected openpgp and openpgp/clearsign packages are not linked into the binary.
statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-5932 applies to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp implementation. Process-agent links other x/crypto packages, which causes module-level scanners to report the parent module, but the built command dependency graph contains neither openpgp nor its Rekor/Trivy dependency path.
statements.action_statement: Re-review this statement if an affected OpenPGP package enters the process-agent command dependency graph. Retire it when scanner matching becomes package-aware or upstream publishes a maintained replacement.
